annotations.title: Forecast Reddit audience size and delivery

description: Ask Reddit how big a targeting set is and roughly what a budget would buy — total reachable audience, the targeted slice, and estimated impressions, clicks and reach. Free, creates nothing, spends nothing, so run it BEFORE building an ad group to sanity-check targeting that may be far too narrow or far too broad. Budget is an ordinary amount in the ad account’s currency. These are Reddit’s estimates, not a guarantee — say so when reporting them.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

bidAmount.description: bid in the ad account currency; needed for paid bid types

bidStrategy.description: BIDLESS (Lowest Cost), MANUAL_BIDDING, TARGET_CPX (Target Cost) or MAXIMIZE_VOLUME. MAXIMIZE_VOLUME is Cost Cap: Reddit retires it on SALES/CONVERSIONS/LEAD_GENERATION/APP_INSTALLS/CATALOG_SALES from 2027-02-10; use TARGET_CPX or BIDLESS there

bidType.description: CPC, CPM, CPV, CPV6 or CPV15; must fit the objective

budget.description: budget in the ad account’s currency (not micro-currency — the conversion is handled)

endTime.description: ISO 8601 end of the forecast window

goalType.description: DAILY_SPEND or LIFETIME_SPEND; LIFETIME_SPEND needs endTime
